Elements hidden via inline style="font-size:0" render nothing and must not appear in the output

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>visible</p><div style=\"font-size:0px; color:rgb(255,255,255)\"><span style=\"line-height:0\">secret zero size text</span></div><p>also visible</p>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
